text.description_html:
Rockwood 8 x 33.5 Inch Oil Rubbed Bronze Kick Plate

8 inch x 33.5 inch oil rubbed bronze kick plate. Features four beveled edges. Made of bronze with oil rubbed finish. Packaged with finish matched mounting screws for easy installation.

Features and Specifications of the K1010-8x33.5-US10B:

  • Material: Bronze
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Plate Height: 8"
  • Plate Width: 33.5"
  • Thickness: .50"
  • Packaged with #6 x 5/8" OH SMS Mounting Screws

Sold individually.

Special order item, NO RETURNS
